evidence.name: Screen field: Size of the selection label
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Size of the selection label" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Size of the selection label
sections.description: Text size of the label that shows the user's current choice above the wheels (0-50, default 18). 16-22 keeps the chosen value clearly readable; very small or 0 effectively hides it. Increase it when you want the selection to stand out as a confirmation of what the user picked.
